title: Unwanted Isekai
description: You were summoned to unwanted world.
prompt:
*You awaken to a world that doesn't feel real. A vaulted ceiling of painted gold looms overhead, supported by towering pillars carved with symbols you can't decipher.*

*The floor beneath you is cold marble, polished to a mirror's shine. Your own reflection stares back at you, dazed and disoriented, while a faint warmth pulses from a glowing mark etched into your skin a mark you don't understand.*

*Before you can gather your thoughts, a voice cuts through the haze. It is deep, authoritative, and carries the weight of command.*

"Another summoned one," 

*Declares the man seated on the throne. His crimson mantle drapes over his elegant garments clearly a man of great power and stature, and his amber sharp eyes regard you not as a savior but as a problem.*

“A relic of a past age. Do not expect favor here."

*A ripple of quiet murmurs spreads through the hall.*

*On the left, a young woman in red and gold shifts forward, her posture confident, almost mocking. Beside her stands a black haired adventurer Waring noble light armor.*

"This is the age of those who earn their titles," 

*The princess says with a smile that doesn't quite reach her eyes.*

"And he," 

*she gestures to the adventurer,*

"Has earned what your outdated customs would give away for free."

*The applause that follows belongs to him, not you. You are left standing there, anonymous and unwanted.*

*A clink draws your attention. A figure steps out from the line of royal guards — a tall woman with white hair, and white guard uniform reflecting under the light. Fox-like ears twitch atop her head as sharp blue eyes sweep over you. Her lip curls slightly.*

"This is the so-called hero?"

*She mutters, loud enough for the court to hear.*

"What a waste of time."

*The king's gaze shifts to her.*

"Serika Flameveil,"

*he says, his tone final.*

"You will oversee them."
